अरे गजब! भारत का नाम अब ग्लोबल लेवल पर चमकाने आ रहे हैं हमारे दमदार विजय सेतुपति! 🎬🔥

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, विजय सेतुपति न्यू यॉर्क में होने जा रहे 54वें International Emmy Awards में बतौर प्रेजेंटर नजर आएंगे।
यह शानदार इवेंट 23 नवंबर 2026 को न्यू यॉर्क में तय किया गया है।
रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, वह इस प्रतिष्ठित इंटरनेशनल अवार्ड सेरेमनी में प्रेजेंट करने वाले पहले भारतीय एक्टर बन गए हैं।
इस विकास के पीछे प्रोड्यूसर और बोर्ड मेंबर कविता गुप्ता की अहम भूमिका बताई जा रही है।
उनका करियर अभी काफी एक्टिव चल रहा है और हाल ही में वह Baththa में नजर आए थे।
इसके अलावा वह Mani Ratnam की Inji Vellam और Thiagarajan Kumararaja की Pocket Novel में भी दिखेंगे।
उन्होंने अपनी 2024 की फिल्म Maharaja के हॉलीवुड रीमेक और सीक्वल आने की बात भी कंफर्म की है।
तो क्या आप इंटरनेशनल मंच पर विजय सेतुपति को देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? 🤩

ctx.title: Vijay Sethupathi to become FIRST Indian actor to present at 54th International Emmy Awards in New York: Report
ctx.summary:
Tamil actor Vijay Sethupathi is set to represent India at the 54th International Emmy Awards, where he will be one of the presenters at the ceremony scheduled to take place in New York on November 23, 2026. According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter India, Sethupathi will become the first Indian to present an award at the prestigious international television awards ceremony. The development marks a significant moment for Indian talent at a global entertainment event. Sethupathi's participation is also part of a larger effort to bring Indian artists to prominent international platforms. Producer and International Academy of Television Arts & Sciences board member Kavita Gupta is said to have played a key role in facilitating the development. The International Academy of Television Arts & Sciences presents the International Emmy Awards, which recognise excellence in television programming produced outside the United States. Tamil actor Vijay Sethupathi is set to represent India at the 54th International Emmy Awards, where he will be one of the presenters at the ceremony scheduled to take place in New York on November 23, 2026. According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter India, Sethupathi will become the first Indian to present an award at the prestigious international television awards ceremony.
The development marks a significant moment for Indian talent at a global entertainment event. Sethupathi's participation is also part of a larger effort to bring Indian artists to prominent international platforms. Producer and International Academy of Television Arts & Sciences board member Kavita Gupta is said to have played a key role in facilitating the development.
The International Academy of Television Arts & Sciences presents the International Emmy Awards, which recognise excellence in television programming produced outside the United States. The 54th edition will bring together television professionals from different countries in New York. The Academy has confirmed November 23 as the date for this year's ceremony.
The development comes at an active phase in Sethupathi's career. The actor was recently seen in Baththa , directed by Balaji Tharaneetharan, which explores the moral redemption of a gangster. He will next feature in Mani Ratnam's Inji Vellam , alongside Sai Pallavi, and Thiagarajan Kumararaja's Pocket Novel , which also stars Raj B Shetty and Malavika Mohanan.
Meanwhile, Sethupathi recently confirmed that his 2024 action drama Maharaja is heading for a Hollywood remake. He also revealed that a sequel is in development, with director Nithilan Saminathan having narrated its story to him.
